grammar.title: This, That, These, Those
grammar.explanation:
Use **this** and **these** for things **near** you. Use **that** and **those** for things **far** from you. Look: **this fish** is on my plate.

**This** and **that** are for one thing. **These** and **those** are for more than one thing. One **lemon**, many **lemons**.

You can use them alone: **that** is my **tea**. Or before a noun: **these soups** are hot.
examples: ***This** coffee is too hot.* (near, one thing)
*Who is **that** man over there?* (far, one thing)
***These** shoes are very comfortable.* (near, many things)
*Can you see **those** birds in the sky?* (far, many things)
